sentences.en: The industrial production processing of Medicago falcate was related in this paper. The product was of good quality, safety and abundant nutrition, and had good market prospect.

sentences.en: The leaves are usually somewhat falcate . The wood is hard and durable, yet easily worked, making it popular for construction of novelty items by local woodworkers.
